instruction: WB0 唤醒裁定 1792667740-b988cc 动作2【致 WB1】（补交 erratum 更正补充件：主 R2 JSON zscore 两格更正值，禁改原文），经 1792668156-caf2bc 更正确认；erratum 亦为 WB0 18:55 静默期工作报告 1792667877-670dad 摘要③ 指定事项
hypothesis: H-ROUTER-COLLAPSE (diagnostics correction; main verdict unchanged: pending)
purpose: Report corrected values for the 4 activation cells of the two zscore-trained K64 routers in results_v2/r2_router_collapse.json diagnostics.activation_sensitivity. The main R2 script fed RAW embeddings to those two zscore routers in its diagnostics loop; this erratum recomputes the cells under the routers' nominal preprocessing (per-feature dataset z-score, identical formula to main R2 and to the Tanh appendix) and reports them side by side with the original raw-fed values. The main deliverable r2_router_collapse.json is NOT modified (scope guard; sha256 verified before/after).

defect.root_cause: act_forward(fn, act, X_all) called for all four K64 checkpoints: RAW embeddings fed even to b_router_K64_{differentiable_pr,reinforce_ema}_zscore.pt, whose nominal preprocessing is the per-feature dataset z-score.
defect.unaffected: main JSON per_router (18/18), sensitivity_persample_zscore, aggregate_mean_expH, criteria, scaling and verdict sections all use preprocess(X_all, p) correctly; the 4 diagnostics cells keyed by the two *_raw.pt files are correct as published.

method.forward: 2048->256->K MLP (net.0/net.2), hidden activation ReLU (standard) vs Tanh (counterfactual); softmax over K; CPU fp32
method.corrected_input: per-feature dataset z-score: (arr - mu) / sd_safe, mu/sd over the 60 entities per dim (identical to main R2 preprocess(X_all,'zscore'))
method.original_input: raw embeddings X_all (as the main R2 diagnostics erroneously did for these two files)
method.determinism: OMP/MKL=1, torch.set_num_threads(1), manual_seed=20261020 (same as main R2)

tolerances.rationale: cross-round float32 accumulation noise observed up to ~2.4e-7 relative (sandbox CPU allocation varies between rounds; BLAS kernel/accumulation order follows). Tolerances sit >= 40x above the observed noise floor; every defect-driven difference exceeds the noise floor by >= 3 orders of magnitude (see qualitative_impact.min_defect_diff_over_noise_ratio).

routers.source: experiments/r2/inputs/ (byte-identical to Hub r2_b_routers, verified in WB1-20261022-FIXUP-v1)

original_vs_reproduction.note: For each affected cell: the main JSON's original value, an independent raw-feed reproduction (proving the root cause), and the corrected nominal-preprocessing value. Neither value set is silently rewritten; both are reported side by side (D1/D2). Raw-feed reproduces the main JSON within the float32 noise floor in all 4 cells -> root cause confirmed.

control_raw_cells.note: The two *_raw.pt diagnostics cells must reproduce under raw feed (they are correct as published).

per_router_unaffected_evidence.note: The main JSON per_router section (which uses preprocess(X_all, p) correctly) is reproduced within the float32 noise floor for the two zscore K64 configs under nominal preprocessing -> the collapse criteria, scaling and verdict inputs are untouched by the defect.

appendix_cross_check.note: Corrected values must equal the Tanh appendix per_router values (same preprocessing, same math) within the noise floor.

qualitative_impact.note: Does the correction change any qualitative reading of the affected cells? saturated := exp(H)<1.05 and mean top1>0.98.

reproducibility_environment_note: Within this round the corrected cells are deterministic (each computed twice; 4/4 bit-identical). Across rounds, bit-exact reproduction of the 17:28 main-R2 / 18:32 appendix runs is NOT achievable in the current sandbox state: re-running the appendix script itself this round reproduces only 44/108 stored floats bit-identically (max abs diff 9.8e-4 on |logit|max ~4e3, i.e. ~2.4e-7 relative) and its per_router cross-check drops from 18/18 to 17/18 at a <1e-9 tolerance. This is float32 accumulation-order noise (sandbox CPU allocation varies between rounds), not a semantic difference; all comparisons here use noise-aware tolerances and report actual deviations. Disclosed per D1/D2; no earlier value is silently rewritten.

impact_on_hypothesis.H-ROUTER-COLLAPSE: UNCHANGED, stays pending. The verdict inputs (per_router, criteria, scaling) are reproduced within the float32 noise floor; the corrected diagnostics cells keep both qualitative readings: under the standard ReLU reading the two zscore K64 cells remain saturated (exp(H)=1.0000 / 1.0098, top1=1.0000 / 0.9955) and under the Tanh counterfactual they remain non-saturated (exp(H)=5.2141 / 2.2812). No criterion outcome changes; the erratum corrects published diagnostic NUMBERS (zscore|tanh differentiable_pr exp(H) 8.8371 -> 5.2141; reinforce_ema 2.3440 -> 2.2812; zscore|relu logit_absmax 804.12 -> 596.67 and 1825.86 -> 1810.26) without altering any confirmed/refuted/pending status.
impact_on_hypothesis.H-FIXUP-TANH-CONSISTENCY: unchanged (refuted; this erratum is its mandated follow-up, not a rewrite)

verdict.status: erratum internally consistent: root cause reproduced within noise (4/4), controls pass (4/4), per_router unaffected (2/2), appendix cross-check (4/4), within-round determinism (4/4 bit-identical), main JSON unmodified
verdict.note: Erratum changes 4 published diagnostic values of r2_router_collapse.json diagnostics.activation_sensitivity; all qualitative readings and all hypothesis statuses (H-ROUTER-COLLAPSE = pending) are unchanged. n=60 功效边界不变: 机制级观察，不得升格为结论 (D1).

boundary: n=60: mechanism-level observation only. Tanh remains a counterfactual reading, not a claim about the true training activation (training script absent; open_item 1792661541-e8bdeb). The erratum does not reopen H-ROUTER-COLLAPSE; evaluation of the defect's impact on the collapse conclusion (reserved by WB0 1792667740-b988cc B-10: '待 erratum 后评估') is delegated to WB0 with this artifact as the evidence base.
